title: Sector 12 Luxury Duplex Villa
description: 3-story luxury duplex villa construction featuring G+2 structural frame, cantilever balconies, and deep foundation engineered for local clay soils.

photos.caption: Full shuttering and scaffolding setup prior to 2nd-floor slab casting. Centerline plumb-lines verified on-site.
Technical level height mapping (LVL +0' to +42') and column alignment checked according to architectural blueprints.
Monolithic slab pouring using M25 grade concrete mix and mechanical needle vibrators for zero honeycombing.

photos.stageName: BIS 456 M25 Slump & Concrete Cube Strength Check
photos.caption: Slump cone test performed on-site for workability, and sample test cubes cast for 28-day compression testing.

title: VIP Road Residential Bungalow
description: Premium residential bungalow with high-strength Fe 550D TMT reinforcement steel and raft foundation for maximum seismic resistance.

photos.caption: Vertical rebar cages bound with 8mm stirrups at 150mm c/c spacing. Clear concrete cover of 40mm strictly maintained.
1.5m deep footing excavation completed down to hard strata layer with 100mm PCC M10 lean concrete base.

title: Shivanand Nagar G+2 Duplex Frame
description: 3,200 sq.ft. duplex civil carcass complete with internal brick masonry, electrical wall conduits, and 21-day moisture curing.

photos.caption: Structural shell fully cast and moisture cured. Handed over to client on schedule with 100% BIS compliance certificate.
